responsibility: This module is the C/C++ bridge and GCC-tree construction layer for the GNU Modula-2 frontend, connecting Modula-2-side compiler logic to GCC’s generic frontend, diagnostics, and middle-end interfaces. Its main responsibility is to initialize the frontend and expose compiler services across the C/Modula-2 boundary, then lower Modula-2 semantics into GCC trees by building types, declarations, expressions, statements, blocks, builtins, and exception constructs through the recurring m2type, m2decl, m2expr, m2statement, m2block, m2convert, m2builtins, m2except, and m2treelib families. Surrounding support code handles source locations and diagnostics (m2linemap, m2color, assertions), frontend option and configuration access, low-level tree inspection utilities, pretty-printing and dump output for gm2-generated IR, and small interoperability definitions for GCC and C-facing types. The presence of runtime-exception graph analysis also shows that this layer includes gm2-specific analysis over generated call structure, but overall the module is best characterized as the frontend integration and lowering subsystem that translates GNU Modula-2 constructs into GCC IR and compiler services.
